title: Disconsolate

inlines.v: DISCONSOLATE, adjective [dis and Latin ] [See Console.] 1. Destitute of comfort or consolation; sorrowful; hopeless or not expecting comfort; sad; dejected; melancholy; as a parent, bereaved of an only child and disconsolate 2. Not affording comfort; cheerless; as the disconsolate darkness of a winters night.
